EconomyCoreCE.description: EconomyCoreCE registers a folder of mission-provided Central Economy files.

file.description: Files lists the source file and CE data type to append or override.

folder.description: Folder is the mission-relative directory containing the registered CE files.

EconomyCoreCEFile.description: EconomyCoreCEFile registers one mission file in an economycore.xml <ce> block.

name.description: Name is the file name relative to the folder on the parent <ce> element.

EconomyCoreClasses.description: EconomyCoreClasses lists entity-class roots that Central Economy tracks.

rootclass.description: RootClasses are class inheritance roots registered with CE.

EconomyCoreDefault.description: EconomyCoreDefault assigns a value to one Central Economy default variable.

name.description: Name is the CE variable name being overridden.

value.description: Value is the configured value encoded as text. Its expected format is determined by the named variable.

EconomyCoreDefaults.description: EconomyCoreDefaults overrides built-in Central Economy default variables.

default.description: Defaults are named CE default values applied by the mission.

EconomyCoreFile.description: EconomyCoreFile configures the CE class registry, default variables, and mission-provided CE file additions or overrides.

ce.description: CE registers mission-relative folders containing CE files to append or use as overrides.

classes.description: Classes declares the game class hierarchies tracked by CE.

defaults.description: Defaults overrides built-in CE default variables for this mission.

economycore.description: XMLName identifies the required `<economycore>` document root.

EconomyCoreRootClass.description: EconomyCoreRootClass registers one game class hierarchy with Central Economy and identifies whether its instances are loot, characters, or cars.

act.description:
Act tells CE how to initialize this class: `character` for players, infected, and animals;
`car` for vehicles; or omitted/`none` for ordinary economy items.

name.description: Name is the root class name from the game's configuration inheritance.

reportMemoryLOD.description: ReportMemoryLOD controls warnings for missing Memory LODs on instances of this class (`yes` or `no`). The documented default is `yes`.
